name: Haveli
signature_dish: sarson da saag with makke di roti
why_it_matters: The default lunch stop for the Chandigarh–Shimla drive — village-themed dining hall, parking large enough for tour buses, portions sized for three. Tripadvisor ranks it #1 of 39 restaurants in Solan; the consistency comes from a fixed Punjabi menu rather than ambition.
insider_tip: Skip the Chinese section and order the saag-roti-lassi combination. They serve gluten-free on request, and the outdoor seating beats the air-conditioned hall in shoulder season.
signature_address: NH-5, near Dharampur, Solan District, Himachal Pradesh 173212

name: Giani Da Dhaba
why_it_matters: The 1970-vintage NH-5 dhaba that travellers used as the marker for 'you're an hour from Shimla'. Founder-family run, demolished and rebuilt during a highway-widening order, but the kitchen rules and recipes carry over. The reference Punjabi-dhaba experience between Kalka and Shimla.
insider_tip: Order the chicken curry — it's the dish locals order and the dhaba's reputation rests on it. Avoid Sundays at lunch unless you have an hour to wait.
signature_address: NH-5, Rouri, Dharampur, Solan District, Himachal Pradesh 173209

name: Himalayan Coffee House
why_it_matters: The oldest coffee house in Solan town — compact dining room on Mall Road that locals have used as the office-after-office meeting spot for decades. Trades on filter coffee and South Indian breakfast staples in a hill town that runs on chai and parathas.
insider_tip: Come for breakfast — the dosas are made fresh in the morning and the filter coffee is the reason regulars keep coming back. By dinner the menu thins out.

name: The Coffee Lodge Cafe
why_it_matters: First-floor cafe on Mall Road — the closest Solan has to a contemporary Italian-leaning space. Pulls Shoolini University students on weekday afternoons; ranks high on Tripadvisor for cafés in Solan town.
insider_tip: The pizza is the reason to come; the Chinese-Indian rest of the menu is filler. Sit by the window for the Mall Road view.
signature_address: Main Chowk, First Floor above Amartex, opposite Old DC Office, Mall Road, Solan, Himachal Pradesh 173212

name: Mohan Meakin Solan Brewery (in-house restaurant)
signature_dish: Solan No. 1 lager with bar snacks
why_it_matters: The brewery, not just the restaurant, is the reason — Edward Dyer's 1855 Solan plant is Asia's oldest continuously operating brewery, and Mohan Meakin runs tours plus an in-house restaurant for Solan No. 1 and Old Monk tasting. The only place in town where the drink has a 170-year provenance to point at.
insider_tip: Book the brewery tour first (contact +91-1792-230450 or solan@mohanmeakin.com) and have lunch after — walk-ins to the restaurant alone miss the actual draw.
signature_address: Mohan Meakin Ltd, Solan Brewery, Mohan Nagar, Solan, Himachal Pradesh 173214

name: Hot Millions
why_it_matters: Dharampur outpost of the Chandigarh-origin fast-food chain — useful for families with kids who want burger-and-fries between Haveli and Giani Da Dhaba on the Solan highway. Mid-tier reviews; included for the option, not the cooking.
insider_tip: Skip if you have time for Haveli or Giani's — Hot Millions is the 'kids want chips' option, not a destination meal.
signature_address: NH-5, Dharampur, Solan District, Himachal Pradesh 173209
